scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix renderers/v17 && npm install --prefix renderers/v18
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck --prefix renderers/v17 && npm run typecheck --prefix renderers/v18
scripts.build:renderers: npm run build --prefix renderers/v17 && npm run build --prefix renderers/v18
scripts.package: npm run build:renderers && npm run package -w packages/ado-extension
